findings.issue: contradicts task clause: P13.1 asks for the fixture tests/fixtures/repos/containers with 'a compose file with three services, two Dockerfiles, one .env.example'. The diff adds the compose file and two Dockerfiles but no .env.example, and no service has an env_file line. The executor disclosed the omission (its Write was refused by a permission setting) and no waiver is recorded in the plan. The env_file key-name path (envKeysOf, scripts/lib/prescan/containers.mjs) is therefore exercised only by the in-memory ct3, never by the committed fixture. The ct5 message at tests/prescan-containers.test.mjs:1009 says '.env.example is not a container file' about a file that does not exist.
findings.resolution: Have the owner add tests/fixtures/repos/containers/.env.example (placeholder names only, e.g. DB_PASSWORD=placeholder) and an env_file: .env.example line on a service, then extend ct1 and ct3 to pin its key names and keep the values out of the fragment. Or amend P13.1's description to drop the file and correct the ct5 message.

findings.issue: The edge type enum gains depends, lineage and artifact, but docs/design.md section 5 (line 107, 'The types come from the artifact (api, static, ... deploy) plus event/queue') is not touched by the phase, so it no longer matches the schema. The model-contract rule asks schema, validate.mjs and design section 5 to agree, and test s3 is titled 'model enums match design section 5' while its expected list was widened without the design text. Severity is low because the enum change is additive, relation-taxonomy.md and model-schema.md were updated, and the change is documentation drift only.
findings.resolution: Add depends, lineage and artifact to docs/design.md line 107 (one phrase, e.g. 'plus event/queue and, from v1.1, depends/lineage/artifact') and the new node kinds pipeline, job, resource, module, model, source where section 5 lists kinds.

findings.issue: P13.5 made merge.mjs create a node per Terraform or Bicep resource and module, per pipeline file and job, and per dbt model and source (150 per stack), and the Edges item of each stack reference was updated to say so. The Nodes item of the same references still tells the explorer the opposite: stack-iac.md:28 'A resource is not an architecture node by itself ... Networks, subnets, security groups ... are plumbing: they belong in notes ... not as nodes'; stack-pipelines.md:24 'A pipeline is not an architecture node by itself'; stack-data-platform.md:29 'a repo of fifty models is not fifty nodes ... a layer is a group, not a node'. The explorer therefore does not know that merge already made the plumbing nodes. Its own system-component nodes are deduplicated only when they share an id or title slug, the same paths, or the same cited line range, so duplicates beside the merge nodes are likely.
findings.resolution: In the Nodes item of stack-iac.md, stack-pipelines.md and stack-data-platform.md, say that merge already makes the level-3 resource, module, pipeline, job, model and source nodes. Then tell the explorer to add only the grouped system-level nodes (service, store, queue) and to cite the same block, so find() reuses the existing node.

findings.issue: P13.10 asks for a nodes-without-edges count in the digest counts 'so a build report shows it'. The digest now carries counts.nodesWithoutEdges, but the build report is the finish output of scripts/pipeline.mjs, whose counts object (pipeline.mjs:1169-1172: nodes, edges, entities, access, relations, drafts) does not read it, so no report shows the figure. Only the synthesizer reads the digest.
findings.resolution: Add nodesWithoutEdges: dj.counts?.nodesWithoutEdges to the counts built at pipeline.mjs:1169 (the digest is already read there as dj) with a test, or reword the clause and the CHANGELOG line to say the digest only.

findings.issue: The merge now writes a new meta.sources row type, queue-unpaired, and P13.11 widened drafts to queue, pull and response flows. skills/architecture-map/references/model-schema.md (the contract reference) still enumerates the source row kinds at line 36 without queue-unpaired and still describes the drafts at line 151 as 'sequences derived from each HTTP entry point'. Reference and writer disagree across the boundary (checklist rule 5). The schema accepts the row (sources items are open objects), so nothing fails.
findings.resolution: Add one sentence for the queue-unpaired row to the sources entry at model-schema.md:36 and widen the drafts description at model-schema.md:151 to the three draft kinds.

findings.issue: The flow player is a headline feature (README, CHANGELOG, roadmap), but only its pure helpers are tested (v9-v11). The DOM glue (flowEnter, flowApply, flowBar, the play timer, the document keydown handler that preventDefaults the arrow, PageUp/PageDown, Home and End keys while the player is open, flowSync on sequence change) runs in no test; the executor says so. A regression in the glue passes the gate. Separately, docs/architecture/archmap.html, the public example the README links, was not re-rendered and has no player (grep count of 'Play on graph' is 0); it was already behind the viewer after P13.5. render.mjs is script-only, so it costs no LLM run.
findings.resolution: Add one test that evaluates viewer.js against a minimal DOM stub, or a vm run, and drives enter, next, play tick and exit. Re-render the committed archmap.html from the committed model and layout with render.mjs before release, or state in the README that the example viewer predates the player.

findings.issue: The new build row paragraph states figures that no tracked artifact backs and no test re-derives: 'the run took 85 seconds', 'all four areas were explored', and the map counts (18 nodes, 14 edges, 1 entity, 3 sequences, 6 views). findings.resolution: Drop the duration and the all-four-areas claim, or record them (duration, areas explored) in the tracked profile or a small tracked note and have r2 check them.

I could not re-run it because the cells are private, so those four counts rest on that note. Its clause 3 wording 'render stays byte-identical for a model without such a sequence' cannot hold literally because the viewer script grew, and r9 only shows the script is model-independent and the static shell is unchanged. Gaps (findings 1 to 4): the nodes-without-edges count is not in any build report, model-schema.md is stale on queue-unpaired and the drafts, the player glue is untested and the committed example HTML lacks the player, and some figures in the evals README row are unsourced.
